title: Package Inclusions Schedule for Replacement System Installations
content:
# Package Inclusions Schedule — Replacement System Installations

This schedule records, for each Replacement System Installations package, which items of scope come with the package and whether the smart thermostat upgrade accessory can be added to it.

| Item | Essential Series | Advantage Series | Performance Series | Performance Hybrid Heat Pump | Signature Series | Signature Elite Communicating |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Whole-home surge protector | Not included | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included |
| Steam humidifier | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included | Included |
| UV germicidal light | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included | Included | Included |
| Condensate pump where the drain needs one | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Manual J load calculation before sizing | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Removal of the old equipment and recovery of its refrigerant at no charge | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| New refrigerant line set | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Start-up and commissioning report at completion | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Smart thermostat upgrade accessory can be added | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No |

Column headings abbreviate the full package names: the Harbison Essential Series System, the Harbison Advantage Series System, the Harbison Performance Series System, the Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System, the Harbison Signature Series System and the Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System.

## Reading the schedule

- "Included" means the item comes with the package; "Not included" means the package does not supply it.
- The condensate pump entry applies where the drain needs a pump.
- The last row is not an inclusion: it records whether the smart thermostat upgrade can be added to the package at all.

## Examples drawn from the schedule (hypothetical homes)

- A hypothetical home receiving the Harbison Advantage Series System has its old equipment removed and refrigerant recovered at no charge and receives a commissioning report, but the package supplies no new line set, no surge protector and no load calculation.
- A hypothetical home receiving the Harbison Signature Series System receives a surge protector and a UV germicidal light with the package, but no steam humidifier.
- Only the Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System includes the steam humidifier.
